items.title: Gucci wählt Shanghai als Schauplatz für Demnas Cruise-Show 2028
items.summary: Gucci will stage Demna's 2028 Cruise show in Shanghai on 17 May 2027, marking 30 years since the brand's first China boutique opened and his first Asia-staged cruise collection. The choice signals Kering's effort to re-engage Chinese luxury consumers directly, with the show landing in the same 72-hour window as Dior's China show, intensifying competition for mainland attention.

items.title: Gucci feiert 30 Jahre in China mit Cruise-Show 2028 in Shanghai
items.summary: German trade coverage of the Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement notes the symbolic weight of returning to China after a prolonged sales slump there, framing the show as part of Kering's broader push to rebuild desirability in a market that has weighed heavily on Gucci's results through 2026.

items.title: Hermès grows, Nike plummets: Interbrand ranking reveals fashion industry winners and losers
items.summary: Interbrand's 2026 Best Global Brands report shows Gucci's brand value falling 30.7% to $8.1 billion, a 24-place drop to rank 93, the sharpest decline of any luxury house tracked, while Hermès overtook Louis Vuitton as the most valuable luxury brand. Analysts quoted frame Gucci's fall as proof that heritage and awareness alone no longer sustain desirability without consistent creative execution and demand generation.

items.title: Gucci loses 30% of its value in a year, but Lyst sees some positives
items.summary: Italian trade outlet LaConceria juxtaposes the Interbrand brand-value collapse against Lyst's Hottest Brands Index, where Gucci still ranks around 5th, arguing the two data points capture different things: cultural buzz under Demna persists even as financial brand valuation erodes sharply, a split the piece says Kering needs to resolve before investors regain confidence.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: Confirms unannounced price reductions implemented across summer 2026: the crystal Padlock top-handle bag down about 30% in France (EUR3,500 to EUR2,450), the Mercato tote 20-25% cheaper, and certain sneakers cut from EUR800 to EUR560-595, alongside 16 new sub-$2,000 handbag models added in the US. Kering frames these as corrections to past overpricing rather than a core strategy shift, as Q3 revenue fell 6% comparably.

items.title: Luxusmarke: Gucci bereitet Mutterkonzern Kering Sorgen
items.summary: German business daily reports that Gucci continues to weigh on parent Kering, citing declining popularity in China and CEO Luca de Meo's acknowledgment that current performance does not reflect the company's true potential as he pushes centralization of decision-making and a leaner retail footprint.

items.title: Gucci to Stage Cruise 2028 Show in Shanghai
items.summary: WWD's trade report on the Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement notes it will be Demna's second cruise collection for the house after his Times Square debut, and the first staged in Asia, positioned explicitly to rekindle attention from Chinese luxury clients during a historically soft period for the category there.

items.title: Gucci Gift with Mariah Carey (holiday film)
items.summary: Gucci's official holiday film directed by Harmony Korine, featuring Mariah Carey in the new Butterfly collection set to her 1994 hit, has surpassed 4.5 million views on YouTube since its 2 November release, making it one of Gucci's highest-viewed owned-channel uploads of the period despite mixed press reception of its tone.

items.title: Mariah Carey's Fully See-Through Knitted Gucci Dress Has Holes Everywhere
items.summary: theFashionSpot's forum-buzz desk covers reaction to Mariah Carey wearing a sheer, hole-knit Gucci piece in New York tied to the holiday campaign press tour; the piece aggregates fan commentary split between praise for the daring styling and criticism that the look undercuts the brand's craftsmanship positioning.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Aggregates TikTok and social comments calling the Gucci holiday film cold and emotionless, with one commenter likening its ad-agency polish without warmth to a budget department-store spot; other viewers called the campaign boring, depressing and lacking any festive feeling despite Carey's involvement.

items.title: Gucci bag help me decide
items.summary: UK parenting-and-lifestyle forum thread where a poster asks the community to help choose between two Gucci handbag styles for everyday use; replies weigh durability, resale value and whether current Gucci pricing still justifies the purchase versus competitor options, reflecting ordinary-consumer price sensitivity rather than campaign-driven buzz.

items.title: Gucci sceglie Shanghai per la sfilata Cruise 2028 firmata Demna
items.summary: Italian trade coverage of the same Shanghai Cruise 2028 announcement, with added domestic-market framing on what the China re-engagement effort means for Gucci's Tuscan manufacturing base and supplier network given the ongoing sales contraction weighing on Italian luxury production volumes.

items.title: Gucci Price Cuts Break Luxury's Biggest Taboo. Louis Vuitton Is Weighing It
items.summary: Forbes argues Gucci's quiet price reductions break a long-standing industry taboo against discounting, framing it as evidence of eroding sector-wide pricing power; the piece reports Louis Vuitton is reportedly weighing similar repositioning while Burberry has instead opted to launch new lower-priced entry lines rather than cut existing prices. Full text paywalled; secondary facts corroborated via theindustry.fashion's reporting of the same underlying price changes.
